summary: Iter11 (StatsBomb Euro 2024 calibration) verified end-to-end. Dataset integrity (8 positions, monotonic percentiles, realistic CB/striker spot-checks), API contract (statsbomb_calibration block with rows/summary/source/license/methodology), Lukas-specific buckets (Passing 9→p90, DM 9→p90, Intensity 6→p25), summary counters {p90:4, p75:3, p50:4, p25:1}, PDF v6 contents (PRO CALIBRATION / STATSBOMB EURO 2024 / Top 25% / p75= / StatsBomb / methodology), and full UI render of [data-testid=statsbomb-calibration-panel] below FIFA Data Twin panel — all PASS. Methodology page shows 3 source cards (StatsBomb / FIFA / FBref) with required text, footer 'Methodology version 1.1'. Regression: all prior 4-Layer Stack + FIFA k-NN + career_brief tests still green (29/30 — the 1 failure is missing `pdftotext` binary in container, NOT an app bug; PDF was verified via pypdf in the new iter11 suite and the iter10 pdf test passed).

minor.issue: Test calls shell `pdftotext` which is not installed in the container — replace with pypdf to make environment-portable. Not a product bug; PDF content verified independently in test_iter11_live.py via pypdf and all required strings are present.

issues: Off Ball Movement and Timing Of Runs both display the same StatsBomb metric label 'Shots per 90' (same p75=2.565); Dribbling and One V One both display 'Dribbles completed per 90' (same p50=0.547). This is by design via the _SCORE_TO_STATSBOMB map but to the user it looks like a duplicate row. Consider mapping Timing Of Runs → a distinct metric (e.g. 'Touches in box per 90' or 'xA per 90') and One V One → 'Dribble completion %' so each ScoutMePlay attribute has a unique anchor.

action_items: (Optional polish) Differentiate the StatsBomb metric mapped to Timing Of Runs vs Off Ball Movement, and to One V One vs Dribbling, so every row anchors against a unique pro metric — keeps the 'real rapport' promise tighter.
(Optional) Swap shell `pdftotext` in test_iter9_independent.test_pdf_regenerates_with_new_sections for pypdf so the test runs in any container.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend StatsBomb dataset is real Euro 2024 (51 matches, 8 positions, 270-min filter) — CB p75 pass_completion 92.5% and striker p75 xG/90 0.49 are league-realistic.
Calibration block correctly includes position_n, matches, source_url, license, methodology — auditable on the wire.
Bucket anchoring is monotonic on score (9→p90, 8→p75, 7→p50, 6→p25, <6→below_p25) and summary counts match row buckets exactly.
FIFA 92% hard cap holds (top neighbor 88.2%). Career brief still attached. Narrative cache still warm after first fetch.
PDF cache versioning (v6) works — regenerates after /app/backend/pdfs/*.pdf purge with all required strings.
Two ScoutMePlay attributes are pointed at the same StatsBomb metric in two places (see design_issues) — not a bug, but a polish opportunity.
